messages:
Owen L.: Hi @people-ops — urgent: my niece was evacuated to my home after the floods overseas. I have an emergency placement letter from the NGO and a temporary guardian note. Can I add them to my benefits now? Passport/SSN delayed due to the disaster.
Maya (People Ops): Oh no, glad they're safe. Short answer: yes, you can start a QLE for emergency placement. We accept emergency placement letters + a local attestation as provisional docs while official papers/passes are delayed.
Owen L.: Great. What specifically should I upload? I only have: NGO placement letter, temporary guardian note signed by my sister, and a school enrollment form from their school. No translation yet.
Tess (Benefits): That should work for provisional enrollment. We usually require: 1) placement/guardian doc, 2) proof of residency (lease or landlord attestation), 3) birth cert or school record, and 4) official ID when available. For disaster cases, we can accept NGO/agency evacuation letters + photos of documents and a sworn statement.
Owen L.: Will premiums be charged immediately or only after final docs? I can't afford double premiums with backpay surprises.
Tess (Benefits): If you enroll within 30 days of placement, coverage is effective back to the placement date and payroll will apply retro premiums. However for emergency provisional enrollments we can hold retro deductions until final approval if you request hardship review. Add "request hardship hold" in the portal note and Benefits will flag for review.
Owen L.: Is 30 days flexible here? The embassy and courier are out of service in the region.
Maya (People Ops): Yes. For region-wide disruptions we routinely extend the window; include any official notices or courier/tracking failures you have to support the timeline. We'll escalate to Benefits leadership for an exception.
Owen L.: Where do I upload? My scan is several photos (~25MB).
Tess (Benefits): Portal path: Benefits portal -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent (QLE). For large uploads use the secure SFTP link on the portal and paste the SFTP receipt in the submission notes. Filename: larsen-zoe-placement-ngoltr.pdf (use lastname-dependent-doc).
Owen L.: Can I redact anything? The NGO letter has other families' names in it.
Maya (People Ops): Yes please redact unrelated names but keep the placement lines intact. If you need help redacting securely, Ops-Support Bot can assist with a secure redaction tool.
Ops-Support Bot: Redaction helper: drop files to SFTP and include "REDACT-HELP" in notes; well return a redacted copy within 24 hours.
Owen L.: Thanks. If I request the hardship hold and they approve, how long until payroll will apply deductions?
Tess (Benefits): If hardship hold is approved, we typically defer retro premium collection for one payroll cycle or until final docs are received, whichever comes first. Payroll will note the deferred flag. If final docs come in later, a one-time reconciliation may apply; Benefits will communicate amounts before deduction.
Owen L.: And what about dependent care FSA / daycare claims? I'm enrolling them so I can start covering after-school care.
Tess (Benefits): You can enroll in dependent care FSA as part of the QLE. Reimbursements are for expenses incurred after the effective date. If hardship hold applies to premiums, it doesn't block FSA elections; claims processing follows the effective date once enrollment is active.
Owen L.: The child's SSN will be months out. Is the SSN required to add them to dental/vision?
Maya (People Ops): SSN not required initially. Add a note: "SSN pending due to disaster; will provide when issued." We'll mark the dependent pending-SSN and update later.
Owen L.: Any risk to COBRA if something changes? Like if guardianship is temporary.
Maya (People Ops): If the dependent later loses eligibility (no longer living with you or guardianship ends), that may be a qualifying event affecting coverage for that dependent and could open COBRA options depending on the plan and timing. Keep docs of any status changes.
Owen L.: How fast is review? I really need confirmation before tomorrows payroll cut-off.
Tess (Benefits): Normally 3 business days for complete submissions. For disaster/emergency cases, indicate "expedite - payroll cutoff" in the portal note and well fast-track same-day if possible. Also DM me the SFTP receipt so I can prioritize.
PayrollBot: Payroll alert: pending-retro-flag for larsen-zoe. Hold requested: noted. Ticket: PAY-12844.
Owen L.: Uploading now: larsen-zoe-placement.pdf (NGO letter), larsen-zoe-guardian-note.jpg, larsen-zoe-school-record.pdf. Adding note: "Request hardship hold; SSN pending; expedite due to payroll cutoff."
Maya (People Ops): Received. I'm flagging this to Benefits lead and payroll. Tess will take point. Hang tight and DM if you don't see confirmation by EOD. :pray:
Tess (Benefits): Got it. Were on it. If we need any redactions or translations well request them. Thanks for the clear filenames.
Owen L.: Thank you all so much. Appreciate the fast help.
Maya (People Ops): Anytime. Update in-thread when you get more docs. :wave:
